record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add a deterministic training-frequency input feature without new learned parameters: multiply each history item's existing embedding by clamp((median_positive_count/count(item))^0.25, 0.5, 2.0), using counts from training interactions only. This may reduce domination by ubiquitous history items. Keep target/candidate embeddings, GRU topology, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Save the scales with each single model and apply identically at inference; retain zero padding.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, scale history embeddings by clamp((median_positive_training_count / item_count)^0.25, 0.5, 2.0). This deterministic feature may reduce domination by frequent items without adding learned parameters. Counts use training interactions only; padding remains zero. The buffer is checkpointed and restored by the existing predictor's dynamic model import. Candidate embeddings, GRU topology, readout, loss, optimizer and training settings remain fixed.
